attributes.action: The social media ban should not be happening.
attributes.additional_details: this petition is about why the social media ban should not happen because it is key for childrens saftey and childhood
attributes.background: I believe that the social media ban should not happen because social media for under 16s is a perfect way of people socialising and this helps them talk to people who have the same interests as them. i also believe that social media is key for childrens saftey as this helps them contact people.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition which calls for the same action: 

Do not ban social media for under 16s
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/757233
